newsitem.title: USA: AMETEK acquires Danish instrument maker.
newsitem.headline: AMETEK acquires Danish instrument maker.

text.p: AMETEK Inc said Wednesday it has acquired Frode Pedersen & Co A/S, a privately-held instrument maker in Denmark.
Terms of the cash acquisition were not disclosed.

Ametek, a global manufacturer of electrical and electromechanical products, said Frode Pedersen makes temperature sensors and transmitters, handheld test equipment and other devises used by process industries.
The Danish company had 1996 sales of about $4 million, it said.
Ametek already operates a unit in Denmark, Ametek Denmark A/S, which makes electronic instruments that calibrate temperature and pressure measurement devices.
